title: SUNDAY MOBILITY
subtitle: SUNDAY. MOBILITY DAY. STILL BARKED. OPEN THE HIPS AND CHEST, OWN THE BALANCE, LIGHT STRENGTH TO FINISH. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE TOMORROW.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. SUNDAY. MOBILITY DAY. FIFTEEN MINUTES. STILL BARKED. OPEN UP, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN LIGHT STRENGTH. DO NOT HIDE BEHIND THAT KEYBOARD, YOU LAZY SOD.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. SUNDAY MOBILITY DONE. HIPS HONEST. BALANCE OWNED. NOW GET BACK TO WORK WITHOUT SITTING LIKE A BLOODY FOLDED DECKCHAIR.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: SCAPULAR ROW
exercises.cue: STAND TALL OR HINGE LIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN SLOW. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR CHEST OPENER AFTER THE DESK. NO YANKING.
exercises.speakStart: SCAPULAR ROWS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. OPEN THE CHEST. DO NOT YANK LIKE YOU ARE STARTING A LAWNMOWER.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE SHOULDERS LOOSE.

exercises.name: GLUTE BRIDGE
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK. FEET PLANTED. DRIVE THE HIPS UP. SQUEEZE THE GLUTES AT THE TOP. HOLD A BEAT. THIS OPENS THE HIPS AFTER THAT CHAIR. NO ARCHING THE LOW BACK.
exercises.speakStart: GLUTE BRIDGES. TWO SETS OF TEN. DRIVE THE HIPS UP. SQUEEZE AT THE TOP. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR HIP OPENER. DO NOT ARCH YOUR BACK LIKE A BLOODY BANANA.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: STEP BACK. FRONT KNEE TRACKS THE TOE. CHEST UP. LIGHT HAND ON A CHAIR IF YOU NEED IT. OWN THE BALANCE.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO SETS. SIX EACH LEG. STEP BACK. CHEST UP. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT WOBBLE ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY WEATHERVANE.

exercises.name: DEAD BUG
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK. RIBS DOWN. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG REACH SLOW. LOW BACK STAYS FLAT. CONTROL BEATS SPEED.
exercises.speakStart: DEAD BUGS. TWO SETS. SIX EACH SIDE. RIBS DOWN. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG. SLOW AND CLEAN. DO NOT FLOP ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY BEACHED WHALE.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. BREATHE. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: SIDE PLANK
exercises.cue: ON YOUR SIDE. FOREARM DOWN. HIPS UP. KNEE DOWN IS LEGAL. ABOUT FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. SHORT AND HONEST. BUILD TOWARD TWENTY LATER.
exercises.speakStart: SIDE PLANKS. TWO ROUNDS. FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. KNEE DOWN IS LEGAL. HIPS UP. SHORT AND HONEST. DO NOT COLLAPSE LIKE A BLOODY DECKCHAIR IN THE RAIN.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. SHAKE IT OUT. I'M WATCHING.

exercises.name: BODYWEIGHT SQUAT
exercises.cue: FEET ABOUT SHOULDER WIDTH. SIT BACK. CHEST UP. HEELS DOWN. LIGHT STRENGTH FINISH. SMOOTH REPS. DO NOT BOUNCE.
exercises.speakStart: BODYWEIGHT SQUATS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. SIT BACK. CHEST UP. HEELS DOWN. LIGHT FINISH. DO NOT BOUNCE LIKE A BLOODY PING PONG BALL.
exercises.speakDone: SQUATS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
